output: html_document
---

Input: `OUTPUT/rds/spe_ruv.rds` (03), `DATA_INPUT/clinical.xlsx`, `DATA_INPUT/IHC_public.xlsx`
Output: Figure1b-1d in `OUTPUT/FIGURES/Main/Figure1` and `OUTPUT/Excel Files/Main/Figure1`; `OUTPUT/TABLES/Study_Summary.xlsx`, `OUTPUT/TABLES/SupplementaryTable3B.xlsx`

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
source("Setup.R")
```

```{r}
spe_ruv <- readRDS(file.path(path_rds, "spe_ruv.rds"))

# Order patients by category for the alluvial plot
meta_df <- as.data.frame(colData(spe_ruv))
patient_order <- unique(arrange(meta_df, Category, Patient)$Patient)
meta_df$Patient <- factor(meta_df$Patient, levels = patient_order)
colData(spe_ruv) <- DataFrame(meta_df)
```

##### Figure 1b
```{r, fig.width = 6.2, fig.height = 5.35}
Figure1b <- plotSampleInfo(spe_ruv, column2plot = c("Patient", "Category", "Segment", "Group")) +
  theme_void() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Alluvial) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +  # column headers above the strata
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x.top = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 3)))
Figure1b

save_plot(Figure1b, "Figure1b.svg", width = 6.2, height = 5.35)  # small export: larger text on the page
save_source_data(dplyr::count(as.data.frame(colData(spe_ruv)), Patient, Category, Segment, Group, name = "AOIs"), "Figure1b")
```

##### Summary numbers and Supplementary Table 2
```{r}
summary <- as.data.frame(colData(spe_ruv))

sum(summary$lib.size)
quantile(summary$GenesDetected, c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75))

tab_seg <- as.data.frame(table(summary$Category, summary$Segment))
colnames(tab_seg) <- c("Category", "Segment", "Count")
tab_seg

tab_group <- as.data.frame(table(summary$Category, summary$Group))
colnames(tab_group) <- c("Category", "Group", "Count")
tab_group

save_tables(summary[, c("Segment", "Group", "Category", "Scan", "Patient")], "Study_Summary.xlsx",
            rownames_to = "Identifier")
```

##### Figure 1c
```{r, fig.width = 8.4, fig.height = 3}
a <- ggplot(tab_seg, aes(x = Count, y = Category, fill = Segment)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Segment) +
  xlim(0, 25) + xlab("") + ylab("") +
  theme_classic()

tab_group <- subset(tab_group, Count > 0)
b <- ggplot(tab_group, aes(x = Count, y = Category, fill = Group)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Group) +
  xlim(0, 25) + xlab("") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())

c <- ggplot(tab_seg, aes(x = Count, y = Category, fill = Segment)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Segment) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  xlab("") + ylab("") +
  theme_classic()

d <- ggplot(tab_group, aes(x = Count, y = Category, fill = Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Group) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  xlab("") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())

Figure1c <- (a + b) / (c + d) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.8, 1)) &
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.direction = "vertical", legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7.5))
Figure1c

save_plot(Figure1c, "Figure1c.svg", width = 8.4, height = 3)  # small export: larger text on the page
save_source_data(list(Segment = mutate(tab_seg, Percent = 100 * Count / ave(Count, Category, FUN = sum)),
                      Group = mutate(tab_group, Percent = 100 * Count / ave(Count, Category, FUN = sum))),
                 "Figure1c")
```

##### Figure 1d
```{r, fig.width = 7.2, fig.height = 2.25}
clinical <- read_xlsx(file.path(path_input, "clinical.xlsx"))

short_names <- c("Atypical endometriosis" = "AE", "Cancer-like endometriosis" = "CLE",
                 "Clear cell carcinoma" = "CCC", "Endometrioid carcinoma" = "EC", "Simple endometriosis" = "SE")

clinical <- subset(clinical, !(Marker %in% c("PD1", "PD-L1 CPS", "PD-L1 TPS"))) %>%
  mutate(Marker = factor(Marker, levels = c("PD-L1 IRS Epithelium", "PD-L1 IRS Stroma", "CD3", "CD4", "CD8", "CD68")))

Figure1d <- ggplot(clinical, aes(x = Category, y = Value, fill = Category)) +
  geom_boxplot(linewidth = 0.4, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Category, labels = short_names) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = short_names) +
  facet_wrap(~Marker, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y", labeller = label_wrap_gen(12)) +  # long marker names on two lines
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.background = element_rect(colour = NA, fill = NA),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "", y = "%", x = "")
Figure1d

save_plot(Figure1d, "Figure1d.svg", width = 7.2, height = 2.25)  # small export: larger text on the page
save_source_data(dplyr::select(clinical, Category, Marker, Value), "Figure1d")
```
